notes: Initial (pre-effective) N-14 8C for three Nuveen CEFs (JDD, JTA, JTD) reorganizing into a newly formed CEF, Nuveen Multi-Asset Income Fund (expected NYSE ticker NMAI). Meeting date, record date and expected closing date are all blank placeholders in this filing ('[], 2021'), so meeting_date, record_date and expected_close are null; the text reads 'expected to take effect on or about [], 2021 or as soon as practicable thereafter'. No outside/termination date: the Agreement may be terminated for uncured breach, unmet condition or board determination. Each Reorganization is contingent on at least one other Target Fund also approving (i.e. at least two of three). subject_names lists the three targets plus the acquiring fund, copied in the capitals of the joint proxy statement heading. 'other' condition = customary certificates and legal opinions (the Agreement also requires a pre-closing distribution of income and gains, Section 8.5). Cash only in lieu of fractional shares; no collar stated (collar null).
